name: jay
description: Jira in a sidebar of its own: your epics and tickets by quarter, each ticket an editor tab, with its text available to the AI agent beside it. Not affiliated with Atlassian.

jay.site.description: Your Jira Cloud site URL, for example https://example.atlassian.net. Used when you sign in with an API token.

jay.signIn.tokenFile.description: A token file another tool keeps: either an OAuth credentials JSON file, or a jira-mcp wrapper or env file with JIRA_URL, JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_API_TOKEN lines (never run). When set, jay uses that login instead of signing in itself, and never writes the file.

jay.signIn.refreshCommand.description: A command that refreshes the token file. jay runs it when the token has expired.

enumDescriptions: Quarters, matched on epics by the quarter patterns
jay.period.description: What the sidebar's second picker lists: quarters, sprints or fix versions.

jay.quarter.fiscalYearStart.description: The month the fiscal year starts, 1 to 12. The default, 1, is the calendar year.

jay.quarter.patterns.description: Templates that mark an epic as in a quarter. 'label:' templates match a label exactly; 'summary:' templates match part of the title. Use {YYYY}, {YY} and {Q}.

jay.placeholderAssignees.description: Display names or account ids that count as unclaimed, so their tickets show under Unclaimed.

jay.columns.description: The columns the sidebar shows on each row, in order. The summary is always shown.

enumDescriptions: The issue page of Atlassian's own extension (atlassian.atlascode), falling back to jay's tab when it isn't installed or fails
jay.ticketView.description: Which view a click on a ticket opens, in the tree, in Jira results and on "Open KEY".

jay.agentFiles.description: Write each open ticket to ~/.jay as plain text (files readable only by you), so an AI agent beside jay knows which ticket is open. Off: no files, and jay.activeIssueFile returns nothing.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js media/*.js test/*.js; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
